component.name: Claude Review
component.summary: Review the changes Claude Code makes

description.p: Claude Review shows the uncommitted changes in your Git projects while Claude Code works on them. Mark files as reviewed, comment on specific lines, and copy the feedback to paste back into Claude Code.

ul.li: Switch between projects at any time
Browse all, staged or unstaged changes with syntax highlighting
Reviewed files are flagged when they change afterwards
Copy your feedback as Markdown, ready to paste into Claude Code
